data.name: Vashu
data.gender_notes: Vashu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Vashu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vas', which means 'to dwell'. This name is believed to bring blessings and good fortune. It is also associated with the Sun and the Sky, symbolizing strength and power. The name Vashu carries the meaning “Bringer of blessings” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vashu usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of blessings and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Invoking the blessings of the divine
data.etymology: Vashu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of blessings.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vashu total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
